department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026, with all materials; late applications may miss funding.

fee_waiver.value: The department cannot grant fee waivers to international students.
fee_waiver.quote: Can International students apply for a Fee Waiver? Unfortunately we cannot grant Fee Waivers to international students.

supervisor.value: Advisors are assigned to admitted students, matched using the statement of purpose.
supervisor.quote: The Statement of Purpose is also used to match admitted students with assigned advisors.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for department funding; only selected applicants receive a package.
funding.quote: All applications are considered for department funding. Applicants will be notified if they are selected to receive a funding package.

entry_route.value: An M.S. (GPA 3.25) is normally required; exceptional students may enter the Ph.D. directly.
entry_route.quote: Normally the M.S. degree is required for admission to the Ph.D. program. Exceptional students, however, may be admitted to the Ph.D. program directly.

notes: TOEFL 87 / IELTS 7.0 are hard minimums; applications below them are not considered.
